_meta.title: Groups, parties, media and campaigns that Wikidata classes by a discriminatory ideology, or as hate groups
_meta.what: Every Wikidata item (not a person) whose political ideology (P1142) is one of these: ethnic: Nazism, White separatism, anti-Arab racism, anti-Catalan sentiment, anti-Chinese sentiment, anti-French sentiment, anti-German sentiment, anti-Hungarian sentiment, anti-Japanese sentiment, anti-Polish sentiment, anti-Romanyism, anti-Russian sentiment, anti-Serb sentiment, anti-Turkic sentiment, anti-Ukrainian sentiment, black supremacy, esoteric neo-Nazism, ethnic supremacism, hispanophobia, nativism, neo-Nazism, neo-Nazism in Russia, neo-Nazism in the United States, racial segregation, racialism, racism, scientific racism, segregationism, white jihad, white nationalism, white supremacy, xenophobia; religion: Islamophobia, anti-Catholicism, anti-Christian sentiment, anti-Hindu sentiment, anti-Islam, anti-Shi'ism, antisemitism, economic antisemitism; lgbt: anti-LGBTQ rhetoric, anti-gender movement, anti-transgender activism, discrimination against LGBTQ people, homophobia, opposition to LGBTQ rights, trans-exclusionary radical feminism; women: anti-gender movement, anti-suffragism, antifeminism, incel, misogyny; disability: eugenics. Also every item Wikidata classes as a hate group (Q3233801 or a subclass), as part of the Ku Klux Klan, or with conversion therapy as its field of work. Fictional things, ideas, terms, positions and events are left out (attacks are in the separate Wikidata attacks layer). Placed at the headquarters town Wikidata gives (P159); else its own coordinates; else the place it is located in or was founded in; else spread inside its country. Items with no place or country are listed but not drawn. This is Wikidata editors' classification, not a legal finding; Wikidata is edited by anyone and is incomplete and uneven between countries.
